description: Read the endpoint health of one of your external functions: the most recent probes, newest first, each with when it ran, whether it passed, its latency and any error, and whether the hourly probe covers the function. Pass function_id. Only the owner can read it. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

name: get_function_health
